description: Returns data {job_id, status: queued} after persisting the request. Read service_interface::job_service::get_job with that exact job_id; schedule another read while queued or processing. Only a terminal successful job provides the original complete response in job.result (the original data is job.result.data); failures preserve the original response in job.result and the error in job.error. Do not repeat the operation because its completion has not been read. Scheduler-fired EDGE_SINK target of the fleet_stall_sweep cron (default every 15 minutes, installed by ensure_fleet_stall_sweep_schedule). Runs one work-keyed fleet stall sweep with trigger='cron' and the default window, logs the outcome, and returns the verdict with the two counts it came from and any advisories. EDGE_SINK so a report-only detector never reaches the inference path on a tick, and so the cron action may omit result_processor_kind, which is its canonical shape. Declares no result or error processor, so a fire stays terminal. Like the direct verb it is REPORT ONLY and refuses nothing: it never drives, clears, compacts, terminates or spawns a session, and an incomplete read yields a named advisory and no verdict. Each fire publishes itself as the sweep's last completed run, which is what makes the sweep's own silence observable. Cron-only wiring (is_discoverable=False); call sweep_fleet_stall to run the sweep directly and see its full result.
embedding_description: Cron-only fire for the work-keyed fleet stall sweep: runs one half-hour-window comparison of produced register work against work that is ready and owned across Codex and Claude sessions, publishes the run so its own silence is visible, and reports a stalled, not-stalled or unmeasured verdict. Not model-callable; the direct equivalent is sweep_fleet_stall.
